Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` and return `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`, importing `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`. This keeps `PostCode.validate` as the validation path without triggering the deprecated-hook warning.

Remove `__get_validators__` from `PostCode`, keep its `validate` method, and declare `Delivery.post_code` as `Annotated[PostCode, AfterValidator(PostCode.validate)]` (import `Annotated` and `AfterValidator`). The field validator normalizes and checks the value while avoiding the deprecated custom-type hook.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Declare `key` with `Field(union_mode="left_to_right")`, for example `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")`, so Pydantic tries the `int` branch before the `str` branch.
Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts string values matching an integer representation to `int` and returns other values unchanged.
Add `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` to `Label` (and import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`) so numeric `sku` values are accepted as strings.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that converts integer inputs to `str` and returns other inputs unchanged; import `field_validator` from `pydantic`.
In from_sensor, pass int(reading) as units instead of reading, so fractional sensor values are truncated before StockLevel validation.
Add a Pydantic v2 field_validator for units with mode="before" that converts numeric inputs to int, truncating fractional readings before the integer field is validated.
Replace the deprecated `parse_obj_as` import and call with `TypeAdapter`: import `TypeAdapter` from `pydantic`, then return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` from `load_users`.
Replace `parse_obj_as` with a Pydantic v2 `RootModel`: define `class Users(RootModel[List[User]]): pass`, import `RootModel`, and have `load_users` return `Users.model_validate(rows).root`.

In `changed_fields`, replace `ProfilePatch(**raw).__fields_set__` with `ProfilePatch(**raw).model_fields_set`, then sort the result.
In `changed_fields`, construct the model and return the sorted keys of `model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` so explicitly supplied fields, including those set to `None`, are included.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("started")` on `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This formats UTC offsets as `+00:00` instead of `Z` in JSON output.

Change `to_wire` to dump with `s.model_dump()` in Python mode, then pass `default` to `json.dumps` that serializes `datetime` values with `.isoformat()` and raises `TypeError` for unsupported types. This avoids Pydantic's JSON-mode `Z` formatting and emits `+00:00`.
Import `field_serializer` from `pydantic` and add a `@field_serializer("price")` method to `Quote` that returns `float(value)`, so `model_dump(mode="json")` emits a JSON number for `price`.
Change `publish` to call `json.dumps(q.model_dump(), default=float)`. The default Python-mode dump retains `price` as a `Decimal`, and the JSON encoder's `default=float` converts it to a JSON number.

Change the `at` annotation on `AuditEntry` from `datetime` to `date` and import `date` from `datetime`; Pydantic will serialize the field as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Import `datetime` and `field_validator`, then add a `@field_validator("at", mode="before")` that converts a `datetime` input to `.date()` and, for ISO strings containing a time, parses with `datetime.fromisoformat(value).date()`. Keep `at: date` so serialization still emits a date.

Change `at` to `datetime`, import `datetime` and `field_serializer`, and add a `@field_serializer("at")` that returns `value.date()`. The timestamp input then validates while JSON-mode serialization emits the date-only value.
